artifacts.summary: Rework decision for mlx-qwen3-asr after the maintainer's #425 review. Scope: bump mlx-qwen3-asr 0.3.5 to 0.4.4 so the finish-path window re-decode replaces the 0.3.5 tail-refine pass that duplicates text at pauses; show no exception on a short tail at a pause; handle upstream issue #31 (non-prefix/non-monotone stable_text) instead of the current RuntimeError abort; reproduce FLEURS zh/en/fr quality under the #444 protocol against Whisper small MLX and Qwen Metal. The reviewed adapter is the maintainer's own 34a2b5e rewrite, which deleted our wrapper layer and its stable-prefix fallback.
